integration.description: Metrics for multi-dataset integration quality and batch harmonization.

metrics.name: integration_silhouette_score
metrics.description: Measure of joint cluster separation after integration.

metrics.name: batch_mixing_score
metrics.description: How well different batches mix after integration.

metrics.name: lisi_integration
metrics.description: Local inverse Simpson's index for batch mixing and biology preservation.

metrics.name: graph_connectivity
metrics.description: Connectivity of cell neighborhoods across batches.

metrics.name: adjusted_rand_index
metrics.description: Agreement between inferred clusters and reference labels.

metrics.name: normalized_mutual_information
metrics.description: Information theoretic similarity between cluster assignments.

metrics.name: silhouette_score
metrics.description: Clustering compactness and separation.

annotation.description: Metrics for cell type annotation and label transfer accuracy.

metrics.name: annotation_accuracy
metrics.description: Fraction of correctly assigned cell type labels.

metrics.name: f1_macro
metrics.description: Balanced classification performance across cell types.

metrics.name: label_transfer_score
metrics.description: Accuracy of transferring labels between datasets.

spatial.description: Spatial analysis metrics for domain detection and spatial autocorrelation.

metrics.name: morans_i
metrics.description: Spatial autocorrelation of gene or feature expression.

metrics.name: domain_separation
metrics.description: How cleanly spatial domains separate in analysis space.

metrics.name: spatial_autocorrelation
metrics.description: General spatial pattern strength across genes or domains.

metrics.name: kbet
metrics.description: Batch mixing quality test for corrected embeddings.

metrics.name: asw_batch
metrics.description: Average silhouette width with batch labels.

metrics.name: batch_entropy
metrics.description: Entropy of batch labels across local neighborhoods.

trajectory.description: Metrics for trajectory inference and pseudotime accuracy.

metrics.name: trajectory_correlation
metrics.description: Correlation between inferred pseudotime and reference ordering.

metrics.name: kendall_tau
metrics.description: Rank correlation of cell ordering along trajectories.

denoising.description: Metrics for denoising and noise reduction quality.

metrics.name: signal_to_noise_ratio
metrics.description: Signal preservation relative to technical noise.

metrics.name: gene_detection_rate
metrics.description: Preservation of detected genes after denoising.

imputation.description: Metrics for imputation accuracy and recovery.

metrics.name: imputation_rmse
metrics.description: Root mean squared error between imputed and true values.

metrics.name: expression_correlation
metrics.description: Correlation of gene expression before and after imputation.

celltype.description: Metrics for cell type identification and marker performance.

metrics.name: celltype_accuracy
metrics.description: Match rate between predicted and reference cell types.

metrics.name: marker_recall
metrics.description: Ability to recover known marker genes for each cell type.

multiome.description: Metrics for multiome modality alignment and concordance.

metrics.name: modality_alignment
metrics.description: Agreement between RNA and ATAC modalities in joint embedding.

metrics.name: joint_clustering_score
metrics.description: Quality of joint clusters formed across modalities.

generic.description: General benchmark evaluation metrics for reproducibility workflows.

metrics.name: repository_discoverability
metrics.description: Whether a code repository can be located from paper or metadata.

metrics.name: clone_reliability
metrics.description: Success rate of cloning identified repositories.

metrics.name: environment_build_success
metrics.description: Whether declared dependencies can be installed successfully.

metrics.name: execution_coverage
metrics.description: Degree to which published reproduction steps can be executed end-to-end.
